envs.name: FEAT_URL
envs.description: feat host base URL — enables the loader's remote resolution (features are fetched from here at boot)

envs.name: FEAT_REQ_MOUNT
envs.description: optional route-path override; 'true' or absent = defaultMount /req

envs.name: FEAT_REQ_<NAME>_TARGET
envs.description: recipe <name>: absolute http(s) URL — PRESENCE of this row ENABLES the route /req/<name>; ${ENV} refs and {{param}} placeholders allowed

envs.name: FEAT_REQ_<NAME>_HEADERS
envs.description: recipe <name>: JSON object of outbound headers — where secrets go

envs.name: FEAT_REQ_<NAME>_BODY
envs.description: recipe <name>: JSON object or string; {{param}} placeholders allowed
